title: How to Use AI for Automated Furniture Removal in Real Estate Photography
summary: Learn how to use AI-powered platforms to remove furniture from listing photos, creating clean, empty spaces for professional real estate marketing.
body_markdown:
## Watch how it works


Prefer to watch? Here is the whole thing, from upload to empty room.


## When should you remove furniture from listing photos?


- **The furniture is old or doesn't match the buyer.** Buyers look at the sofa instead of the room
- **The room is cluttered.** Too much stuff makes it look smaller than it is
- **The seller already moved out.** But the photos were taken before
- **You want to restage it.** An empty room is the starting point for a new look


## Start with a good photo


The AI rebuilds the floor and walls that were hidden behind the furniture. The more of the room it can see, the better the result.


- Use a bright photo. Turn on the lights and open the blinds
- Shoot wide, so the corners and the whole floor are in the frame
- Use the original photo, not a screenshot
- Keep the camera straight, so walls don't lean
- Accepted files: PNG, JPEG and JPG


## How to remove furniture from a photo, step by step


1


### Sign up for free


Go to Apply Design and click **Try for free** . No credit card needed.


2


### Upload your photo and choose Remove Items


Click **Upload Images** and drag in your photo. Tick **Remove Items** , then click **Upload** .


3


### Wait a few minutes


Your photo shows **Image processing** while the AI works. In about 3 to 5 minutes it changes to **Image ready to edit** , and your empty room is ready to download.


4


### Check it before you list it


Zoom in and take a quick look:


- Walls meet the floor and ceiling in clean, straight lines
- The floor looks natural all the way across
- No shadows or marks where furniture used to be
- Windows, doors and outlets are still where they belong

## Remove, then restage


An empty room is a great start, but many buyers find it hard to picture living there. With Apply Design you can remove the furniture and stage the room again, all on the same photo.


- Show buyers the room empty and fully furnished
- Try different styles for different buyers
- No rental furniture, no moving trucks


Same room, restaged with new furniture.


See how in our guide to[virtually staging a room from a photo](https://www.applydesign.io/post/how-to-virtually-stage-a-room-from-a-photo-step-by-step-guide) , or follow the[Auto Stage steps in our help center](https://support.applydesign.io/getting-started/pCqPLoHJvwgwLDLKrr4QmF/auto-staging/tzLi4Tn9AAub534pSoba94) .


## Let buyers know the photo was edited


Many MLSs ask you to say when listing photos have been digitally changed. Check your local rules.


- Add a short note like "Virtually edited"
- Keep the original photo in the listing or ready to share
- Don't hide things that stay with the home, like cracks, stains or damaged floors
